subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the three stale assertions are repaired, do the workflow and security owners approve all twelve third-party action revisions on the exact final head?
rationale: The revisions execute in CI, code-scanning, token-minting, agent, and publishing contexts under a protected security label, so automated source verification cannot replace owner acceptance.

options.title: Approve repaired final head
options.body: Review the verified upstream diffs, require the focused guard checks to pass, and approve the exact head after all assertions are synchronized.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, Codex, or publishing action revisions if owners prefer narrower review and rollback scope.

options.title: Pause the grouped bump
options.body: Keep the batch open until the privileged revisions can be reviewed and validated together.

recommendation.title: Approve repaired final head
recommendation.body: Review the verified upstream diffs, require the focused guard checks to pass, and approve the exact head after all assertions are synchronized.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle owns the workflow tree in CODEOWNERS and is the best available coordinator for the security-owned subpaths.
